instruction: Grab the kitchen microwave with slanted shape's handle and pull to open it.

source.instruction: Grab the kitchen microwave with slanted shape's handle and pull to open it.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the microwave, which was at x = -4 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left gripper forward and right towards (1, 4, 94).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+31, +23, +0) cm, now 16 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the microwave
